description: Dependency updates target develop; develop to main stays a separate promotion.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes are proposed at once, outside the weekly schedule and without the release-age wait.

packageRules.description: Minor, patch, digest and pin updates arrive as one weekly PR. Majors stay separate PRs for review.
npm and PyPI releases are proposed after three days, so a release that is withdrawn again never reaches a PR. Security fixes are exempt (vulnerabilityAlerts).
WebMCP host pins (ais-webmcp, insight-ui-webmcp, insight-ui) move with the release order in the open-core standard, not with Renovate.
Renovate looks .python-version up on Docker Hub; the Python line follows the CI matrix instead.
.github/workflows/npm-publish.yml must stay byte-identical to the central npm publish template; its pins move there first.
